question: When I share documentation links, people have to scroll through the whole page to find the relevant table or code example. Can I make URLs that jump directly to specific content in the middle of a page, not just section titles?
ground_truth: To create direct links to specific content elements like tables, code blocks, or paragraphs (not just headers), wrap the content with the `<Anchor>` component and assign it a custom anchor ID. For example: `<Anchor id="pricing-table">[your table content here]</Anchor>`. You can then share links using the hash symbol format like `https://yoursite.docs.com/page#pricing-table`, which will jump directly to that content. This works for any content type - tables, code blocks, paragraphs, or other elements - giving you the flexibility to create stable deep links to arbitrary content blocks throughout your documentation, not just section headers.
